PITANJA.P: How can I adopt an animal through LuckyTails?
PITANJA.O: Sign up, fill in the adopter form, find an animal you're interested in and schedule a shelter visit. The adoption itself (paperwork, picking up the animal) happens directly with the shelter.

PITANJA.P: Why is my animal listing pending?
PITANJA.O: Every new listing goes through moderation to make sure the information is accurate before it becomes visible to users.

PITANJA.P: What if my visit time overlaps with another appointment?
PITANJA.O: The system only shows time slots that are actually free within the shelter's working hours, so overlaps cannot happen.

PITANJA.P: Can I chat with the shelter directly in the app?
PITANJA.O: The app does not include a chat feature - the shelter's contact details (phone and e-mail) are shown on the animal's and shelter's profile.

PITANJA.P: How do I delete my account?
PITANJA.O: The 'Profile' page has an option to permanently delete your account.

PITANJA.P: How can I leave a review for a shelter?
PITANJA.O: You can only leave a review (rating and comment) for a shelter you have actually visited - the option appears on the shelter's profile once the shelter has approved your visit request, the appointment time has passed, and the visit is recorded as completed. If you don't show up, the shelter can mark that, and a review is no longer possible for that visit.

PITANJA.P: Do I log in with my e-mail or my username?
PITANJA.O: You log in with your username and password, not your e-mail. The e-mail is only used to confirm registration and for status notifications.
